title: workbench-object-values
description: Workbench Object property values (L4 capability gap D-G1, owner 2026-10-20; ADR-025, ADR-035): GET /api/v1/workbench/objects/{type}/{id} (workbench verbs `object_fields` and the audited object read). Per schema property: its value (text, or canonical JSON text, at most 2000 characters, `truncated` when cut) when the member's per-property READ holds; withheld with its name only when the owner restricted its group (`restricted`) or the member's role does not derive it (`not_permitted`), or its value names a Consumer being erased (`erasing`); or missing. An object the member may not read, including one whose Consumer is being erased, is 403; every read is audited. NexLoop target contract; server-derived identity required. This is not an existing upstream EIOS/Pi API.
